observations: Steal An Egg (106 days), Brookhaven, DONT SPLASH (22 days), RIVALS, 99 Nights in the Forest and Murder Mystery 2 lead the cumulative pillar, the same top group as yesterday apart from 99 Nights replacing Blox Fruits.
Survive Your Ideas (+68, 33 days) and Ragdoll Physics (+37, 27 days) rose most, followed by Evermore High (+17), Can You Pass A Driving Test? (+16) and Southern Mudding (+13, 419 days).
The fallers are all 25-36 days old: +1 Anime Eyes (-14), Climb The Rake Tower, Drive a Cart Downhill and Fake an Egg (-13 each) and Cat Battles (-11).

Nine games entered, including Become the Potato!, Cut a Rock, Clean the Moon, Catalog Avatar Runway and the 1,281-day-old Attack on Titan Revolution; nine left, including Destroy Verity, Flee the Facility, Realistic Car Destruction and Realistic Ragdoll Playground.

By age the median pillar percentile runs from the 46th at 15-42 days to the 64th past a year, and the 85-122 day band sits lowest (27th, only 4 games), a thin hint for the mid-life trough (H-mp-009, 48%).
patterns: Updates consistently go with staying power: games more than 28 days past their last update stay far fewer days (r=-0.60), and weekly updaters stay longer (H-mp-018, 65%).
Higher prices tend to go with dominance: a median pass above 149 R$ holds at 70% (H-mp-001) and median products above 400 R$ split days on the chart at r=+0.44, with game age the likely confounder.
Verified creators (r=+0.28) and studio-scale complexity (H-mp-015, 65%) tend to stay longer, though creator size is partly a result of success.
Ragdoll (r=+0.37) and Egg (r=+0.30) are the strongest title keywords on the pillar, carried mostly by Ragdoll Physics and Steal An Egg, two template waves holding the chart at once.

Among profiled loops, '+1' incrementals (78th median percentile), combat PvP (66th) and physics sandboxes (64th) sit high, while idle tycoons (23rd) and collect-upgrade-rebirth loops (27th) sit low, in line with the cash-tycoon penalty (H-mp-017, 64%).

outliers.name: [⭐UPD] Survive Your Ideas
outliers.note: Rose 68 places at 33 days with only 9 products and 6 passes, a player-input survival game whose reach outruns its store; it is also among the least efficient earners.

outliers.name: Attack on Titan Revolution
outliers.note: Entered at 1,281 days, updated today, but sits weakest on the pillar; an update-driven re-entry rather than sustained dominance.

outliers.name: Spot and Mark!
outliers.note: Entered while 25 days past its last update, against the update-gap pattern; it sits near the bottom, so the pattern may still catch up.

observations: Donation hubs again lead efficiency (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS), with New Journey, Clover RPG and Build and Burn close behind.
Flee the Facility, Deagle Arena, Survive Your Ideas and Ragdoll Physics (no products) are the least efficient: large audiences with little to buy.

King Legacy (+154) rose most on a fresh update, followed by FERAL Animal Survival (+129), Ragdoll Physics (+111), Net a Fish! (+105) and Steal a Superpower! (+105); Rebirth Champions: Ultimate (-89), Candy Kingdom Defense (-71) and It Hears The Water (-69) fell most.

Fifteen games entered, among them four young anime RPGs or fighters with reroll stores (Ishin, A Bizarre Run, Cloverlines and the already-listed Shibuya), Raycity RB and 7 Days as a Pet; thirteen left, including Arsenal and several Halloween titles.
Efficiency consistently rises with age, from the 28th median percentile at 15-42 days to the 62nd past a year (H-te-001, 85%).
patterns: High prices consistently pay: median products above 79 R$ split efficiency at r=+0.49 (H-te-005, 92%), and median passes above 399 R$ (H-te-025) and a top pass above 999 R$ (H-te-006) also hold at 92%.
Physics sandboxes (r=-0.70) and steal-and-defend loops (r=-0.62) are consistently the weakest earners per player, and Egg (r=-0.75) and Steal (r=-0.61) are the worst title keywords.

RPGs (r=+0.47), roleplay hubs (75th percentile), tower defense (73rd), story adventures (71st) and PvP combat (66th) consistently earn more per player; a reroll-store hypothesis for young anime RPGs is proposed today at 30%.
Complexity (rho=+0.25), larger servers (r=+0.29) and longer descriptions (r=+0.27) consistently go with efficiency, all three also tracking game age.
Solo loops consistently earn less per player (r=-0.29, H-te-028 at 92%), the single sharpest social split on this chart.

outliers.name: [🐉UPD 11 PART 1🎃] King Legacy
outliers.note: Rose 154 places at 2,518 days with no passes and 181 products; a big update re-awakening spending in a lapsed audience rather than new players.

outliers.name: Ishin
outliers.note: Entered at #115 with 125 rerolls at 3-5 R$ each, far below the 79 R$ median-price line (H-te-005), so cheap repeatable rerolls can still earn when the game is an RPG.

outliers.name: [🐟] Net a Fish!
outliers.note: Rose 105 places at 24 days with 22 passes, an idle fishing tycoon in a loop family that usually earns poorly; a heavy pass store and luck products likely carry it.

observations: 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] (30 days), Be a Soccer Legend (27 days), Cozy Lucky Scoop Order, KRN: Crosshair, Monster Maker and +1 Boxing Battle Evolution lead early momentum.
30 Floors Up (+35, 14 days), Monster Maker (+30), Be a Soccer Legend (+25), DONT SWIM (+21) and Cozy Lucky Scoop Order (+21) rose most.
Become the Potato! fell 40 places at 15 days, the biggest drop, after Prison Dodgeball (-26), Ice Cream Shop [Anomaly] (-15), Climb The Rake Tower (-15) and Steal Eggs From Tsunami (-13).

Fourteen games entered, including Sweep The Moon, FERAL, Climb and Steal an Egg, +1 Power Fruit Evolution and two old games re-surfacing on updates (Wax ASMR Tower at 507 days, Lethal Ape at 1,094 days).
Games updated in the last day moved a median +0.5 against -1.5 for the rest, the first small edge for same-day updates in several days.
patterns: A skill-based competitive core consistently goes with lower positions among young games (H-tt-054, 75%; within-age effect -0.50), and PvP social play also sits lower (within-age -0.42, H-tt-011 at 64%).
Survival framing tends to go with faster climbs (H-tt-048, 69%; r=+0.45) and co-op consistently holds higher (H-tt-023, 74%).
Luck products (H-tt-025, 72%) and luck passes (H-tt-039, 71%) consistently go with lower positions at launch, and a big product list does too (products_n within-age -0.36), proposed as a test today.
Weapons tend to sit higher among young games (within-age +0.38), proposed as a test today, while reward-flex thumbnails sat lower (within-age -0.36), against H-tt-006's direction (58%).
Simulation-job loops hold the 90th median percentile (3 games) and sports loops the 75th, while idle tycoons (8th) and RNG roll loops (3rd) sit at the bottom.

outliers.name: Become the Potato!
outliers.note: Fell 40 places at 15 days with 288 products, 10 passes and a 74% like ratio, the clearest case of a heavy launch store and an RNG loop going together with lost momentum.

outliers.name: Monster Maker
outliers.note: Rose 30 places at 17 days against the creature-theme penalty (H-tt-022, 53%); its player-built monsters likely read as a creation tool rather than a creature collection.

outliers.name: [🌈🚂UPDATE] Wax ASMR Tower
outliers.note: Entered at 507 days, outside the 4-month window, re-surfacing on a new themed tower; an update bump rather than early momentum.

observations: Ragdoll Physics (27 days), Ragdoll Research (11 days), Survive Your Ideas, DONT SPLASH, MALAM SAMA OPAH and Be a Soccer Legend top the chart: two ragdoll sandboxes and three survival or horror titles.
Sweep The Moon (+81, 16 days), Button Battles (+66), Ragdoll Realism (+48), FERAL (+44) and Project Web (+43) rose most.
Become the Potato! (-44), Hug Tower & TROLL Traps (-42), Ragdoll Wars! (-41), Ice Cream Shop [Anomaly] (-31) and Detect and Steal an Egg (-30) fell most.

Eighteen games entered, among them three ragdoll sandboxes (two with identical pass and product lists), MALAM SAMA ATOK, Net a Fish! and +1 Baddie Evolution; sixteen left, including Clone Baby Care (Anomaly) and Criminal Simulator.
The newest games (0-14 days) hold the 73rd median percentile against the 47th at 15-42 days (H-uc-005, 62%).
patterns: Co-op loops consistently rank higher (H-uc-019, 81%) and PvP loops consistently lower (H-uc-038, 81%); party minigames sit at the 21st median percentile (H-uc-044, 69%).
Selling revives consistently goes with higher positions (H-uc-021, 82%; within-age +0.37), in line with survival and horror loops ranking high (horror 92nd percentile, H-uc-057 at 72%).
Higher like ratios consistently go with higher positions (H-uc-006, 79%), and luck products and luck passes tend to go against them (H-uc-018, 66%).

Physics sandboxes are now 20 of 99 profiled games and tend to rank above average (60th percentile, H-uc-036 at 71%), but the templated entries sit low: Untitled Ragdoll Game entered at #68 against Ragdoll Research at #2.
Verified creators sit higher within age (+0.33), proposed as a test today; group publishing already tends to help (H-uc-054, 65%).

outliers.name: Sweep The Moon 🌕
outliers.note: Rose 81 places at 16 days as a '+1' incremental, against H-uc-003 (60%); a calm sweeping chore with 97% likes may read differently from the usual '+1' grinders.

outliers.name: [VOICE] MALAM SAMA ATOK
outliers.note: Entered at 10 days with a 53% like ratio, against the like-ratio pattern; it rides the regional folk-horror audience that MALAM SAMA OPAH opened.

outliers.name: Terraform
outliers.note: Sits near the bottom at 178 days and 12 days without an update, an old voxel sandbox outside the young-game band this chart rewards.

summary: The ragdoll wave widened again: three more ragdoll sandboxes entered Up-and-Coming, Ragdoll titles are 14% of that chart, and Ragdoll Physics rose 37 on Most Popular while sitting among the least efficient Top Earning games; H-x-021 rises to 77%. Two of the new entries (Ragdoll Verity Sandbox, Realistic Ragdoll Physics) share an identical pass and product list under different groups, a sign of reskinned templates.

Templates still buy reach, not revenue: steal-and-defend (r=-0.62) and physics sandboxes (r=-0.70) are the weakest earners per player while leading the breakout charts, so H-x-002 rises to 55%. Steal/egg clones fell on three charts at once while Steal An Egg stays #1 (H-x-011 to 38%).

Competition splits the charts again: social=pvp and a competitive core go against Top Trending (-0.46, -0.49) and Up-and-Coming (-0.44, -0.50), while PvP combat consistently earns more per player on Top Earning (H-te-022, 92%).

Halloween fallout continued: four Halloween-tagged games left Top Earning while King Legacy rose 154 on a fresh update (H-x-027 to 50%). Regional folk horror is renewed as a new hypothesis after MALAM SAMA ATOK entered Up-and-Coming.

Gameplay videos are still unlabelled for the eighth run: Dragon Adventures, Creatures of Sonaria, Sol's RNG and Basketball: Zero are frames_ready with 0 frames and no contact sheets. No new outside research was waiting. 46 games were profiled today; many of the auto-retired qualitative ideas were left at 25% or below and dropped out under the three-day rule.
progressions: uc→tt remains the most common transition (206 entries, up from 200, median 2 days), ahead of tt→mp (167, up from 161, median 2 days).
uc→te (129, 5 days), tt→te (120, 4 days) and uc→mp (110, 4 days) keep showing breakouts reaching revenue and dominance within about a week, while tt→uc stays at 1.

Ragdoll Physics now holds #1 on Up-and-Coming and rose 37 on Most Popular at 27 days, while FERAL (20 days) climbed Up-and-Coming (+44) and Top Earning (+129) and entered Top Trending on the same day.
